title: Epidural injection for back pain
what: The doctor injects an anti-inflammatory medicine next to a nerve in the spine. This reduces back and leg pain.
why: For back pain that spreads into the leg or arm, for example with a slipped disc, when pills and exercise help little.
duration: the procedure usually takes 15 to 30 minutes, with about 30 to 60 minutes of observation afterward
tell_doctor: Blood thinners, as the doctor will say what to stop and when
Allergies, especially to iodine and contrast
Diabetes, since the medicine can temporarily raise sugar
Pregnancy or the possibility of it
A fever or infection the day before

prepare.title: Images
prepare.text: Bring your spine MRI or CT, which the doctor uses to choose the injection site.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually you can have a light breakfast. If sedation is planned, check with the clinic.

prepare.title: Ride
prepare.text: It is better to have someone take you home, since your leg may be temporarily numb.

bring: The referral and your MRI or CT images
steps: You lie on your stomach or sit
The skin on your back is cleaned and numbed
Under X-ray or ultrasound, the doctor inserts a thin needle
A little contrast is given to check the spot
The medicine is injected, the needle is removed, and a plaster is put on
feel: Pressure or fullness in the back, sometimes spreading into the leg
Your leg may temporarily go numb or weak
after: Take it easy today, and it is better not to drive
The effect usually comes in a few days
Sometimes the pain is even a little worse in the first days
Keep doing your exercises as your doctor advised
red_flags: A severe headache that eases when lying down
A fever over 38°C (100.4°F), or redness at the injection site
Growing weakness in the legs or numbness in the groin: call emergency services
You cannot pass urine or hold it: call emergency services

faq.q: How long does the effect last?
faq.a: It varies, from a few weeks to months. For some people the effect is weak.

faq.q: How many of these injections can I have?
faq.a: The number is limited. Your doctor decides based on the result.

reminders.text: Back injection tomorrow. Bring your MRI images and list of medicines. Ask someone to take you home.
